test_cases.title: Full refund on day 10 after delivery is processed
test_cases.preconditions: Order #10045 Delivered 10 days ago, €89.90, paid by Visa, owned by the logged-in customer
steps: Log in as the order owner
test_cases.expected: Full refund of €89.90 to the original payment method (Visa); order status becomes Refunded

test_cases.title: Refund on day 30 after delivery is accepted
Refund on day 31 after delivery is rejected
test_cases.expected: Rejected with 'Return window has closed'; no money moved

test_cases.title: Shipped order (not yet delivered) cannot be refunded
test_cases.expected: Refund option is not available; API rejects the request

test_cases.title: Confirmation email shows the refund amount
test_cases.expected: Email shows €89.90 and the payment method

test_cases.title: Duplicate request with the same request ID does not refund twice
test_cases.preconditions: Refund for #10045 already processed with request ID R-1
steps: Send the refund request again with request ID R-1
test_cases.expected: No second refund; API returns the original refund result

test_cases.title: Customer cannot refund another customer's order
Refund writes an audit log entry
test_cases.expected: Entry with who, when, amount €89.90 and reason

test_cases.title: Payment provider failure leaves the refund Failed
test_cases.expected: Refund status Failed, can be retried; customer is not told it succeeded
